statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed; Tail remains low while geopolitical, rate and oil Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening is the principal conditional path-risk checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail during closure; reopening remains the main path-risk checkpoint
body: NQ remains closed, so persistent one-way structure cannot be observed. Saudi escalation, high yields and expensive crude keep Stress extreme, while unchanged China lending benchmarks and stronger Gulf export routing limit incremental shock pressure.

lookbackSummary: Tail stayed low across all 24 prior hourly assessments, ranging from 10% to 16%. Stress remained high to extreme while the weekend closure prevented live confirmation of a pathological one-way NQ path.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low through the scheduled closure, rises conditionally into WATCH around the Sunday Globex reopening, and falls below WATCH in the base case only if early price discovery becomes two-way with meaningful retracements.

forecast.analysis: In the final pre-open hour, gap uncertainty rises. Tail approaches WATCH but remains below it because the opening price path and first retracement are still unknown.
At the scheduled Globex reopening, conditional Tail reaches WATCH. The key checkpoint is whether the opening gap extends repeatedly with shallow or failed retracements.
WATCH persists conditionally if the first post-open hour shows repeated extension or weak retracements; two-way price discovery would argue for faster normalization.
Conditional WATCH remains while the early reopening path is assessed. Meaningful retracements would reduce Tail; continued one-way efficiency would keep risk elevated.
The base case falls below WATCH if price discovery becomes two-way and retracements are meaningful; a failed retracement sequence would invalidate that normalization.
drivers: Conditional normalization after early price discovery

forecast.analysis: If the reopening shock is absorbed without repeated extension, Tail continues to ease. Persistent directional efficiency would instead require reassessment.
Conditional risk continues to normalize if cross-assets stabilize and NQ stops holding near session extremes; otherwise Tail would remain higher than this base case.
A two-way overnight range would keep Tail low despite elevated macro and geopolitical Stress; renewed one-way extension would contradict this base case.
If Asian-session liquidity develops without persistent extension, Tail remains low. New geopolitical or energy discontinuity would reopen the risk window.
The late forecast base case remains low Tail if overnight mean reversion is functioning; persistent trend efficiency or fresh shocks would require a higher assessment.
